description: Source code for Airtable document loader class implementing INode interface, including methods for loading data from Airtable API, handling pagination, and document processing.

classes.name: Airtable_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Class implementing Airtable data loading as an INode, with configuration for Airtable API interaction and document processing.

classes.name: AirtableLoader
classes.description: Class extending BaseDocumentLoader to fetch and paginate Airtable records, converting them into documents.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader with node data, fetches credentials, and loads documents with optional text splitting and metadata handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads documents from Airtable, either all or limited, based on configuration.

methods.name: fetchAirtableData
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST request to Airtable API to fetch data, with error handling.

methods.name: createDocumentFromPage
methods.description: Creates a Document object from an Airtable record page.

methods.name: loadLimit
methods.description: Loads a limited number of Airtable records with pagination.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads all Airtable records with pagination.
